U.interpretation: This classification concerns the prespecified IoU screen only. A meaningful Mask75, coverage, AUC or FPR improvement can still be valuable; assess magnitude, uncertainty and trade-offs separately. Three epochs and reused dev do not establish mechanism, AP, or absence of potential.
